name: mindslice
description: Portable long-term memory: isolated Markdown slices, standing memory in every session, controlled evolution.

interface.longDescription: Long-term memory as plain Markdown cards in a folder you choose. Your standing memory (persona, reply language, standing rules) reaches every session through startup hooks, the MindSlice MCP tools search, read and write the rest, and changes to always-loaded memory wait for your approval.
defaultPrompt: Remember that I prefer concise answers in English
Review the memory changes waiting for my approval
